q: In which year did the outbreak of the First World War take place?
The outbreak of the First World War : 1914.
Which of these events took place in 1861?
the assassination of Archduke Franz Ferdinand at Sarajevo
the abolition of the slave trade in the British Empire
the proclamation of the Kingdom of Italy
the final abolition of slavery in the French colonies
The proclamation of the Kingdom of Italy : 1861.
Which of these events took place in 1870?
the signing of the Treaty of Versailles
Adolf Hitler becoming Chancellor of Germany
the proclamation of the French Third Republic
The proclamation of the French Third Republic : 1870.
